card: This PR adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan when called on temporary owning containers, diagnosing dangling views at compile time. It separates overloads using std::ranges::borrowed_range to avoid flagging valid views, specializes enable_borrowed_range for leveldb::Slice, and annotates the span overload of UCharCast to preserve lifetime tracking. This follows merged PR 36164, which added equivalent lifetime diagnostics to util/string.h helpers.
changed_since_previous: Renamed UCharSpanCast to UCharCast and added LIFETIMEBOUND to its span overload so lifetime tracking is preserved across span conversions.
evidence: Follow-up to merged PR #36164 ('util: diagnose dangling views of temporary strings'), which implemented the same lifetimebound diagnostics for string helpers.
problem: MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan create non-owning views of their inputs, allowing callers to construct spans from temporary owning containers that immediately dangle without warning, risking use-after-free bugs.

risk.why: Incorrect template constraints or lifetime annotations would cause compile-time errors or diagnostics rather than silent runtime regressions.

summary: This change adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan for inputs that are not borrowed ranges, diagnosing dangling views created from temporary owning containers. It also renames helper UCharSpanCast to UCharCast and annotates its span overload to propagate lifetime tracking through nested conversions. In dbwrapper, it specializes std::ranges::enable_borrowed_range for leveldb::Slice so the non-owning view does not trigger false positives.
